row: 翡翠水庫位於新北市北勢溪，大壩為雙曲線薄拱壩，壩高 122.5 公尺、壩頂長 510 公尺，1979 年開工、1987 年完工，是大台北重要的供水水庫。

airspace.zh: 在台灣飛行無人機須依民航局規定，並以「遙控無人機管理資訊系統」查詢禁限航區；翡翠水庫屬水源保護區，進入與活動須依臺北翡翠水庫管理局規定申請；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Drones in Taiwan follow CAA rules; check no-fly and restricted zones in the CAA drone system; the reservoir is a protected catchment, and entry needs the reservoir administration's approval. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

crest.note: the crest, about 172.5 m above sea level

res2.note: the reservoir in the Beishi River valley

plant.note: the power station below the dam

pool.note: the plunge pool closed by a low weir (副壩)

river.note: the river below the dam, toward the Xindian River

ops.note: beside the north end of the dam

tagline.zh-Hant: 一道薄拱，守住大台北的水
tagline.en: One thin arch that holds Greater Taipei's water

zh: 新北市山區的北勢溪上，
一座弧形的混凝土大壩攔出翡翠水庫。
en: On the Beishi River in the hills of New Taipei,
a curved concrete dam holds back the Feitsui Reservoir.

zh: 壩高 122.5 公尺，壩頂長 510 公尺，
是一座雙曲線薄拱壩。
en: It is 122.5 m high with a crest 510 m long:
a double-curvature concrete arch dam.

zh: 壩後的水庫總容量約 4.6 億立方公尺，
集水區面積 303 平方公里。
en: The reservoir behind it holds about 460 million cubic metres,
fed by a catchment of 303 square kilometres.

zh: 壩頂是一條弧形的通道，
從上方看，大壩向上游拱起，像一張拉開的弓。
en: Along the crest runs a curved roadway;
seen from above, the dam bows upstream like a drawn bow.

zh: 正上方看最清楚：
拱的凸面朝向水庫，承受水的推力。
en: From straight above it is clearest:
the curve bulges toward the reservoir, facing the push of the water.

zh: 壩下游是桂山發電廠翡翠分廠，
一部 7 萬千瓦的機組，每年發電約 2.2 億度。
en: Below the dam is the Feitsui unit of the Guishan power station:
one 70 MW generator producing about 223 million kWh a year.

zh: 大壩下方的消能池由副壩圍起，
放水時用來消減水流的能量，保護河床。
en: Below the dam a low weir encloses a plunge pool,
which absorbs the energy of released water and protects the river bed.

zh: 沿著北勢溪往上游，飛向大壩。
下游的溪水匯入新店溪，再流進大台北。
en: Flying up the Beishi River toward the dam.
Downstream, the river joins the Xindian River and flows on into Greater Taipei.

zh: 水庫沿著北勢溪的河谷延伸，
四周是保護良好的森林。
en: The reservoir stretches along the Beishi River valley,
surrounded by well-protected forest.

zh: 翡翠水庫以供水為主要目的，
防洪與發電為次要目的。
en: Feitsui exists above all to supply water;
flood control and power come second.

zh: 接下來三部影片，看它的結構、施工與影響。
壩體斷面為依公開資料的估計造型。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: The next three films look at its structure, its construction and its impact.
The cross-section of the dam is an estimate from public data.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 雙曲線拱壩如何把水壓交給山壁
tagline.en: How a double-curvature arch passes the water's push to the rock

zh: 拱壩的道理和石拱橋相同：
水的推力沿著弧線，被傳到兩岸的山壁。
en: An arch dam works like a stone arch bridge:
the push of the water is carried along the curve into the rock on both sides.

zh: 水平方向是一道拱，
垂直方向也微微彎曲，所以稱為「雙曲線」拱壩。
en: Across the valley it forms an arch,
and it curves gently from top to bottom too: hence "double-curvature".

zh: 因為力量由兩岸岩盤承擔，
拱壩比同高的重力壩薄得多，用的混凝土也少得多。
en: Because the rock on both sides carries the load,
an arch dam is far thinner than a gravity dam of the same height and uses far less concrete.

zh: 壩頂最薄，越往下越厚，
因為水越深，壓力越大。
en: The dam is thinnest at the crest and thicker toward the base,
because the deeper the water, the greater the pressure.

zh: 拱壩需要堅硬完整的岩盤，
狹窄的河谷與穩固的兩岸，是選擇壩址的關鍵。
en: An arch dam needs hard, sound rock;
a narrow valley with firm sides was the key to choosing the site.

zh: 放水時，水流落入下方的消能池，
副壩讓池中保持水深，減少沖刷。
en: Released water falls into the plunge pool below;
the weir keeps the pool deep and reduces scour.

zh: 發電廠利用水庫放水的落差發電，
發完電的水再流回北勢溪，往下游供水。
en: The power station uses the drop of the released water to generate electricity,
and the water then flows back into the river to supply users downstream.

zh: 操作大樓與監測系統，
隨時掌握水位、壩體與水質的狀況。
en: The operations building and monitoring systems
keep constant watch on water level, the dam and water quality.

zh: 有效容量約 3.36 億立方公尺，
颱風來時也能暫存洪水，減輕下游的負擔。
en: Its active storage is about 335.5 million cubic metres,
and during typhoons it can hold back floodwater and ease the load downstream.

zh: 一道薄薄的拱，
擋住了數億立方公尺的水。
en: One thin arch of concrete
holds back hundreds of millions of cubic metres of water.

zh: 拱、壩肩岩盤與消能池，
是翡翠大壩結構的重點。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: The arch, the rock abutments and the plunge pool
are the key parts of the Feitsui Dam.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 從 1979 年開工到 1987 年完工
tagline.en: From the start of work in 1979 to completion in 1987

zh: 1970 年代，大台北的用水需求快速增加，
需要一座能長期穩定供水的水庫。
en: In the 1970s Greater Taipei needed more and more water,
and a reservoir that could supply it reliably for decades.

zh: 北勢溪的這段河谷狹窄、岩盤堅硬，
適合興建拱壩。
en: This stretch of the Beishi River had a narrow valley and hard rock,
well suited to an arch dam.

zh: 1979 年 8 月開工，
先開挖兩岸壩肩，把壩體嵌進岩盤。
en: Work began in August 1979:
first the abutments were cut into the rock on both sides to seat the dam.

zh: 混凝土分塊、分層澆築，
壩體一層一層往上長高。畫面示意由下往上。
en: Concrete was placed block by block and layer by layer,
and the dam grew upward. Shown here from the bottom up.

zh: 壩下游同時興建發電廠與消能設施，
讓放水能同時發電。
en: Below the dam the power station and the energy-dissipating works were built too,
so that released water would also make electricity.

zh: 1987 年 6 月大壩完工，
水庫開始蓄水，河谷慢慢成為湖面。
en: The dam was completed in June 1987,
the reservoir began to fill, and the valley slowly became a lake.

zh: 工程經費約新台幣 114 億元，
前後將近八年。
en: The work cost about NT$11.4 billion
and took nearly eight years.

zh: 為了保護水質，
水庫周邊劃為水源保護區，嚴格管制開發與進入。
en: To protect the water,
the land around it became a protected catchment, with building and access strictly limited.

zh: 完工至今，大壩持續接受監測與維護，
經歷多次颱風與地震考驗。
en: Since completion the dam has been monitored and maintained continuously,
through many typhoons and earthquakes.

zh: 施工畫面為示意，
實際工程依壩體分塊與岩盤條件分段進行。
en: The construction scenes are illustrative;
the real work proceeded block by block to suit the rock.

zh: 八年的工程，
換來大台北數十年的穩定供水。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: Eight years of work
gave Greater Taipei decades of reliable water.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 供水、防洪、發電與水源保護
tagline.en: Water supply, flood control, power and a protected catchment

zh: 翡翠水庫調節新店溪的水量，
服務人口約 630 萬人，約占全台四分之一。
en: Feitsui regulates the flow of the Xindian River
and serves about 6.3 million people, roughly a quarter of Taiwan.

zh: 乾季時，水庫放水補充河川流量，
讓下游的取水口能穩定取水。
en: In the dry season the reservoir releases water to top up the river,
so the intakes downstream can draw a steady supply.

zh: 颱風豪雨時，水庫可以暫存洪水，
再有計畫地放流，減輕下游的淹水風險。
en: In typhoons and heavy rain it can hold back floodwater
and release it in a planned way, reducing the flood risk downstream.

zh: 集水區的森林受到保護，
水質優良，是翡翠水庫最重要的資產。
en: The forest of the catchment is protected,
and its clean water is the reservoir's greatest asset.

zh: 保護水源也代表限制：
水庫內禁止游泳、釣魚與一般遊船，參觀須事先申請。
en: Protecting the water also means limits:
no swimming, fishing or ordinary boating, and visits must be arranged in advance.

zh: 發電是附帶的功能：
利用放水的落差，每年提供約 2.2 億度電。
en: Power is a by-product:
the fall of released water provides about 223 million kWh a year.

zh: 乾旱的年份，水庫的存量格外受到關注，
節約用水與跨區調度都是重要的配套。
en: In dry years its storage is watched closely,
and saving water and transfers between regions are important back-ups.

zh: 壩頂與水面之間，
是大台北一天天的生活用水。
en: Between the crest and the water below
lies Greater Taipei's everyday water, day after day.

zh: 四十年來，這座薄拱壩默默運轉，
是城市背後看不見的基礎建設。
en: For forty years this thin arch dam has quietly done its work,
an unseen piece of infrastructure behind the city.

zh: 翡翠水庫的四部影片到此結束。
歡迎到「AERO 無人機模擬飛行」親自飛一趟。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: This ends the four films on the Feitsui Dam.
Come and fly here yourself in the AERO drone flight simulator.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.
